conversion: Combine exterior and original interior; align interior with a 1.6 uniform scale about the origin.
Separate entrance leaves; open the left leaf outward 110 degrees and retain the right at 0 degrees. Remove the duplicated closed interior leaf.
Preserve source BaseColor/alpha; map roughness from G and metallic from B. Convert DirectX normal green to the glTF convention.
Bake coordinate and mirrored-winding conversions; retain 3868551 source triangles. Record recovery of 132 zero corner normals from valid source faces.
Reduce textures to 128 pixels to fit resident material budgets. Cook automatic LOD once and derive fixed finest from the same scene asset.

validation.rendererParity: Not certified. Full Blender comparisons still show indirect-visibility and alpha/emissive differences.
